yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!
Table_name=str.RandStr(5)
yakit.EnableTable(Table_name, ["key", "size", "url"])
ossx = func(url, is_https, marker) {
    rsp, req = poc.Get(
        url, 
        poc.https(is_https), 
        poc.timeout(8), 
        poc.query({"marker": marker, "max-keys": 1000}), 
    )~
    xmls = xml.dumps(string(rsp.GetBody()))
    xmls = xml.Prettify(xmls)

    next_marker_regex = `<NextMarker>(.*?)</NextMarker>`
    next_marker = re.Find(string(xmls), next_marker_regex)
    next_marker=next_marker.ReplaceAll("</NextMarker>", "")
    next_marker=next_marker.ReplaceAll("<NextMarker>", "")

    contents_regex = `<Contents>.*?<Key>(.*?)</Key>.*?<Size>(\d+)</Size>.*?</Contents>`
    contents = re.FindAll(string(xmls), contents_regex)
    for i in contents {
        size_regex = `<Size>(\d+)</Size>`
        key_regex=`<Key>(.*?)</Key>`
        size = re.Find(re.FindAll(i, size_regex)[0], `\d+`)
        key = re.Find(i, key_regex)
        key = key.ReplaceAll("<Key>", "")
        key = key.ReplaceAll("</Key>", "")

        u =url+ "/" + string(key)

        // a=f`key：${string(key)},size：${string(size)}, url：${string(u)}`
        // yakit.Info(string(a)+"\n")
        yakit.Output(yakit.TableData(Table_name, {"key":string(key), "size":string(size), "url":string(u)}))
    }
    return next_marker
}

url = cli.String("url", cli.setRequired(true))
cli.check()

ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(url)
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
if port == 0 {
    addr = ip
}
is_https = str.IsTLSServer(addr)


next=ossx(url, is_https, "")
//yakit.Info(string(next))
page=1
for next{
    yakit.Info(f`正在获取第${page}页的数据`)
    next=ossx(url, is_https, next)
    page++
}
help: 遍历存储桶，用正则匹配的方式获取url
